# apple_app_asset_library_placement_order (Resource)

Sets the display order of the placements in a placement group of an App Store version, custom product page or product page optimization treatment localization. In-app event placements can't be ordered. List every placement of the group. Destroying the resource leaves the order as it is. Import it with `<localization_id>/<placement_group>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_asset_library_placement_order" "iphone" {
  app_store_version_localization_id = apple_app_store_version_localization.en_US.id
  placement_group                   = "IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE"
  placement_ids = [
    apple_app_asset_library_placement.tour.id,
    apple_app_asset_library_placement.home.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `placement_group` (String) Placement group to order, such as `IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE`.
- `placement_ids` (List of String) IDs of every placement in the group, in display order, e.g. `[apple_app_asset_library_placement.first.id, ...]`.

### Optional

- `app_store_version_localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an App Store version localization, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_localization.en_US.id`. Exactly one localization is required; changing it creates a new resource.
- `custom_product_page_localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a custom product page localization. Exactly one localization is required; changing it creates a new resource.
- `experiment_treatment_localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a product page optimization treatment localization. Exactly one localization is required; changing it creates a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The localization's ID and the placement group, as `<localization_id>/<placement_group>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_asset_library_placement_order.iphone
  identity = {
    id = "b3a9b4c2-d2de-43f4-ad8c-71c5ebe301d1/IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The localization's ID and the placement group, as `<localization_id>/<placement_group>`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_asset_library_placement_order.iphone b3a9b4c2-d2de-43f4-ad8c-71c5ebe301d1/IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE
```
